AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
  Teleconference Location: Commissioner Manoukian
  552 Alpine Drive, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during
  regular business hours.

,·
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  July 10, 2019
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:06 pm.

  Present: Devine, Ghazarian, Chair MacCarley
  Absent: Manoukian, Abkarian

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of May 8, 2019.

  Motion: Devine  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian, Abkarian

  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of June 12, 2019.

  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Chair MacCarley
  Vote: Ayes: Ghazarian, Chair MacCarley
  Abstained: Devine
  Absent: Manoukian, Abkarian

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  None

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

6.  CLASS SPECIFICATIONS FOR APPROVAL (MARTIN)
  a) Action: Approval of class specification for Assistant Chief Information Officer as submitted.
  b} Action: Approval of class specification for Network Manager as submitted.
  c)  Action: Approval of class specification for PC Specialist Supervisor Series as submitted.
  d)  Action: Approval of class specification for IT Projects Manager as submitted.
  e)  Action: Approval of class specification for Department Applications Manager as submitted.
  f)  Action: Approval of class specification for GIS Manager as submitted.
  g)  Action: Approval of class specification for Systems Engineer Series as submitted.

  Commissioner Devine requested staff to add a sentence to future agenda memos that would specify if the
  appropriate bargaining unit(s) had any objections to the relating agenda item. The class specifications were
  approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Devine  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian, Abkarian
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of July 14, 2019
,  Page 2 of 2

7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- HOUSING APPLICATIONS MANAGER (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Housing Applications Manager as submitted.
  The class specification for Housing Applications Manager was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Devine  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian, Abkarian

8.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

9.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  None
10.  CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Appointment: Reinstatement Request-Deputy Director of Human Resources.

  Reported Out:
  Public Employee Appointment - Reinstatement Request
  The Commission unanimously voted to approve the public employee reinstatement request.

11.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:56 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and c  ecord of  ·ngs of July 14, 2019.

  Mark MacCarley, Chair
